raw_idea_generation_core.basis: Runtime session transcript claude_20260712_171240.jsonl records model=claude-fable-5 on the orchestrator dispatch message (line 3184) and on all 44 sidechain assistant records of the P3R2-A idea-architect subagent (parent_tool_use_id toolu_01JQ5s1KCavFy5efSKCUyVcg), with zero sonnet records in that sidechain. MODEL_ROUTING_LOG.jsonl lines 173/177 match.
raw_idea_generation_core.missing_proof: Runtime effort was never recorded anywhere in the transcripts; xhigh is evidenced only as a request (launcher configuration in LAUNCHER_LOG.md, agent frontmatter effort=xhigh quoted in routing entries, 01_MISSION/MODEL_EFFORT_POLICY.md). Therefore the 'at high or xhigh effort' half of the claim cannot be confirmed from runtime observation.

adjudication_screening.basis: Same transcript records model=claude-fable-5 on the elegance-judge dispatch (line 4214) and on all 36 sidechain assistant records of that subagent (parent_tool_use_id toolu_015FAZtwrecqPweTB9zApGvq), with zero sonnet records. MODEL_ROUTING_LOG.jsonl lines 183/184 match.
adjudication_screening.missing_proof: Same effort gap: observed effort is absent from every runtime record; only requested xhigh is evidenced.

later_artifacts.basis: Both sampled deep dives were generated during the documented ChatGPT continuation (MODEL_ROUTING_LOG.jsonl lines 308-313, source=chatgpt-continuation, requested_model='GPT-5.6 Terra', actual_model=unknown; CHATGPT_CONTINUATION_LOG.md P6 section). The strongest contemporaneous logs therefore affirmatively place generation on a requested non-Claude route, contradicting Fable-5 provenance for these artifacts. The folder note 40_DEEP_DIVES/_about.md ('Ten Fable/xhigh reports') conflicts with these logs and is rejected as unsupported; the corpus's own final audit 99_AUDIT/FABLE_ADJUDICATION.md likewise records 'Actual runtime model / effort: unknown / unknown (not exposed; not inferred)'.
later_artifacts.missing_proof: Which exact GPT-family model and effort actually ran is unknown (no continuation runtime transcript exists in the corpus). Unknown identity does not rescue Fable provenance: no evidence anywhere logs these artifacts as Fable-generated.
